gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-georama: Georama reads approachable and open, its c curling wide like a bracelet pulled apart, capitals barely rising. And the real hook is Woodgod, a commanding vintage display face whose tall lowercase nearly reaches its capitals.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-gidole: Gidole is clean, its terminals parted like open scissor blades. Down a full column it reads smoothly with neon-tube consistency in every stroke, while Woodgod brings a commanding vintage voice above.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-golos-text: Sturdy and contemporary, Golos Text fills the line with tall letters of one stroke width and a widely parted s. Yet Woodgod, commanding and vintage, makes the steady text below feel easy to settle into.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-hind-guntur: Woodgod hits like stamped metal type, vintage and commanding up top. Hind Guntur is the steady half, strokes drawn with one fixed nib and wide gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-hind-madurai: Woodgod comes in loud, vintage and commanding, wide channels into every bowl. Hind Madurai, a sans of uninterrupted monoline strokes, carries paragraphs smoothly, its s curves opening wide at both ends.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-huninn: Woodgod is loud, vintage, and commanding, tall lowercase nearly touching capitals. Huninn, a modern sans-serif with ballpoint-pen strokes and s terminals held away from the body, reads comfortably through many lines.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight reads like bent rope, short ascenders barely showing. Down a full column its curve tails stay well back from the body, while Woodgod supplies the commanding vintage voice.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-karla: Commanding and vintage, Woodgod towers in tall lowercase that nearly reaches its capitals. Karla, modern and approachable, has a gaping c and a tall middle band, so lines read stocky and friendly.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-kufam: Woodgod's lowercase grows tall enough to nearly reach its capitals. Kufam brings contemporary tube-like lines in a single track width, and that vintage-against-modern gap is what makes the pair work.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-lexend-deca: Woodgod is commanding and vintage, its tall lowercase nearly matching the capitals in height. But Lexend Deca, a sans with unshaded lines poured at one width, carries a full page of text without ever swelling.
